run_swap_meili_indexes: run the swap_meili_indexes script to swap main and temp Meilisearch indexes using --meilisearch_key and --meilisearch_url arguments
swap_meilisearch_indexes: swap two Meilisearch indexes atomically using the swap_indexes function from meilisearch_helper
wait_for_task_completion: wait for a Meilisearch async task to complete using the wait_for_task_completion decorator
wait_for_all_addition_tasks: wait for all document addition or update tasks to finish on a specific Meilisearch index
get_meili_chunks: split a list of objects into chunks that stay under the 95 MB Meilisearch payload size limit
